in_marathi.name: Tanuj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Given by God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tanuj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tanuja', meaning 'given by God'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity, Lord Shiva, and is considered a powerful and auspicious name for a baby boy.
